description: This source file defines the PHP class 'VPCLatticeClient' within the 'Aws\VPCLattice' namespace. It extends the 'AwsClient' class and provides method annotations for interacting with the Amazon VPC Lattice service API, including methods for creating, deleting, and updating resources, as well as listing and retrieving configurations. The file primarily serves as a client interface for the AWS SDK for PHP to facilitate communication with the Amazon VPC Lattice service.
